//: Geekatplay Studio - ComfyUI custom node packages are loaded by file path, not by import name (see ComfyUI's nodes.py load_custom_node), so the folder name is allowed to contain hyphens. A hyphen is not a legal Python identifier, so static checkers cannot name this package and report every relative import inside it as unresolved. That is a naming artifact, not a defect - the imports work at runtime. ComfyUI itself is not on the checker's path either.
